verdict.rationale: Clerky offers real-time collaboration, attorney review/comment, customization of key terms, and full audit logging of document set changes, which supports a 'controlled workflow instead of email attachments' for its own formation/equity documents. However, there is no evidence of redlining, track-changes, or multi-round negotiation with external counterparties—Clerky's workflow is field-based data entry and e-signature for standardized startup legal docs, not general contract redlining. Missing for 10: explicit redline/track-changes tooling, version comparison, negotiation cycles with external parties, and support for arbitrary (non-template) contracts.
